_what: Settings of tool:take-me-there. `link`: the names the address a notice carries gives the arrangement and the tour under (the page reads them from its address). `notice_kind`: the kind the notice is sent as. `category`: where the arrangement and tour are kept unless the caller names one. `focus_sizes`: the thing's pane against what is put beside it. `fallback_points_at`: where the walkthrough points when the waiting row names no control of its own; a request may bring its own for a host that marks its screens differently. `step_id`, `step_placement`: the walkthrough step made when the caller gives none. `trigger`: how the walkthrough is asked for by name and finished when the thing is done; its once key is `once_key` with the held key after it.

words.needs_thing: Say which thing to take them to: thing, the id of one card from tool:what-is-waiting-on-me (or the key of a batch of them).
words.needs_waiting: Give waiting: the answer of tool:what-is-waiting-on-me, as { sections: [{ cards }] } or { cards }.
words.needs_screens: Give screens: a list of { path_prefix, tool_id, route_input_from_query? } rows, one for each address path that opens a screen.
words.bad_screen: screens[{index}] is { path_prefix: a path that starts with /, tool_id, route_input_from_query?: [names] }.
words.bad_origin: own_origins is a list of origins such as https://example.com; {origin} is not one.
words.not_waiting: {thing} is not waiting on them now (it is not made yet, or it is already done), so nothing was opened: make it first, then take them to it with the id tool:what-is-waiting-on-me gives.
words.outside: {thing} opens outside their own places ({address}), so nothing was opened; give them that address instead.
words.ready: {title} is ready to open as the main pane. The arrangement is returned to save and open; nothing was saved here.
words.notice: A notice is ready to send with a link that opens it on any device; nothing was sent here.
